'''Rishii village''' was a village of the local [[Rishii/Legends|Rishii]] located on the [[Sky Ridge Island]] of [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. During the [[Galactic War]] [[Arankau]] was the chieftain of the village.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rishii village appears as an area on Rishi in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion.<ref name="SWTOR" />
